If the number of boys in school S6 are 30 percent more than the number of girls in school S1, then number of girls in schools S3 and S4 is what percentage of number of boys in schools S6 and S1 ? (correct to two decimal places)
solution:
**Given:**

Boys(S6) = Girls(S1) + 0.3[Girls(S1)]

Girls(S1) = 500

**Solution:**

Boys(S6) = 500 + 0.3(500) = 650 

Girls(S3 + S4) = m x Boys(S6 + S1)
